value.rationale: The smallest complete graph supporting a strict initial opinion majority is a natural microscopic boundary. The complete finite-state formula detects immediate breakdown of classical voter fixation martingale from homogeneous nonzealous initialization, an exact reversal across the neutral minority baseline due solely to one initial zealot, and a uniformly longer stopping time. These concrete quantities benchmark simulations of full-reset persistent-voter mechanisms and distinguish them from similar confident-voter rules; no large-network significance is asserted.
